name: Time ~Hohoemi no Mukou ni~
source:
Today, at the usual time, a girl wakes me up and stuffs my bag with textbooks and notebooks (...)
"Good morning, master..."
That was my sister, Hotsuki, dressed in a maid's outfit... Time flows.
The changing seasons and the unchanging thoughts... What is the truth hidden in the maid clothes? A scenario-oriented, pure love adventure game.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20050505162818fw_/http://circlemebius.sakura.ne.jp/time.html]Developer's site[/url]]
translation:
今天，像往常一样，一个女孩叫醒我，把课本和笔记本塞进我的包里（……）
“早上好，主人……”
那是身着女仆装的妹妹穗月……时间流逝。
季节的变迁，不变的思念……女仆装里隐藏着什么真相？一款剧情纯爱冒险游戏。

[来自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20050505162818fw_/http://circlemebius.sakura.ne.jp/time.html]开发者网站[/url]]
